description: Rug-pull / honeypot check before you buy a token. Inspects mint and freeze authority, token-2022 extensions, proxy and ownership state, privileged functions and top holder concentration. Returns a 0-100 risk score with itemised flags. 0.20 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: token_audit
